:::{#thm-bernoulli-mean}
#### Expectation of the Bernoulli distribution

If $X \sim \Ber(\prob)$ ([Bernoulli distribution](random-variables.qmd#def-bernoulli)),
that is, $\P(X = 1) = \prob$ and $\P(X = 0) = 1 - \prob$, then:

$$\E{X} = \prob$$
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

::: proof

$$
\ba
\E{X}
&= \sum_{x\in \rangef{X}} x \cd \P(X=x) && \text{(definition of expectation for discrete r.v.)}
\\&= \sum_{x\in \set{0,1}} x \cd \P(X=x) && \text{(range of Bernoulli r.v. is } \{0, 1\} \text{)}
\\&= \paren{0 \cd \P(X=0)} + \paren{1 \cd \P(X=1)} && \text{(expand sum over } x = 0 \text{ and } x = 1 \text{)}
\\&= \paren{0 \cd (1-\prob)} + \paren{1 \cd \prob} && \text{(substitute Bernoulli PMF values)}
\\&= 0 + \prob && \text{(multiplication by 0 and 1)}
\\&= \prob && \text{(addition of 0)}
\ea
$$

:::
